name: orc_offdesign_scroll_expander
title: Off-design ORC with semi-empirical scroll expander and moving-boundary plate heat exchangers
summary: R1233zd(E) organic Rankine cycle solved off-design: Lemort semi-empirical scroll expander (P_M mode), pump on similarity laws with rated curves, two SWEP P200THx140 plate heat exchangers in a zone-wise moving-boundary formulation with Zivi charge. The low pressure is closed by the imposed 7 K pump-suction subcooling, as the source's iteration variable.

verification.summary: Expander and pump verified against a re-run of the source Python components (LaboThapPy f03f7f47): pump N_pu/eta_pu to 10 digits, expander h_ex/W_dot/eta_is/N_rot/eps_v to 6e-6. The cycle block implements the source's utilisation closure (sum(w)=1); Levenberg-Marquardt drives its residual from 2.2e5 to 25.5 but exceeds the iteration budget, so no cycle solution is stored. Details in README.
verification.reference: LaboThapPy f03f7f47 standalone component runs (expander_semi_empirical, pump_curve_similarity)
verification.notes: max_rel_diff concerns the expander+pump subset only (T_w vs the rounded Python print); the HX equations have no source reference (see README verification section).

history.action: continuation (orchestrator review): LMTD guard fixed - initial residual 4.7e8 -> 5.8e5; state-point initials added; still failing

source formulation implemented (orchestrator round 2): per-zone utilisation w = UA_req/UA_avail with the source closure sum(w)=1, w-weighted pressure drops and w-proportional charge; LM reaches residual 25.5 (from 2.2e5) but exceeds the iteration budget - still failing

review of the failing models: stays failing (solver convergence; Try Harder fails); LMTD guard bug of the translation corrected; diagnosis and CoolSolve hints in README; maintainer may consider dropping (no cycle reference, heavily modified translation)

diagnosis: Review 2026-11-01: square, solution expected, but the 134-eq. HX block does not converge, also with Try Harder: LM goes 2.2e5 -> 6.2e3 in ~50 iterations then stalls (damping 1e8, zero step = local minimum, likely the flat regions of the Max(dT,1E-6) clamps); TrustRegion/Newton after it exceed 20 min. LMTD guards corrected (5th IF argument was the 0/0 form). No reference for the cycle (source example cannot run).
